# Stage 1: Intake

Historical validation test: the idea as it stood when the Salary repository was created (2026-11-23). Evidence is judged against what was knowable on that date. Everything below was public by then.

## The idea in the submitter's words (verbatim, do not edit)

> A platform that lets meme coin creators distribute their coin's creator fees across different wallets, including salary-style recurring payments to the developers and contributors building the project.

## Restated without expansion

| Element | Statement |
|---|---|
| Problem | Creator fees from a meme coin go to one wallet; the people building the project are paid informally, or by selling tokens |
| Who has it (specific segment) | Solana meme coin teams (mainly Pump.fun) with more than one active contributor and meaningful creator fees |
| Proposed solution | A platform that routes creator fees to several wallets and pays contributors on a salary-like schedule |
| Why now | Pump.fun creator fees are paid in SOL on every trade |
| How it makes money (as submitted) | Not specified (a 1% payday fee and a Pro plan were later floated and withdrawn [S2]) |
| Token involved? | Undecided ("Salary token" deferred [S2]) |

## Hypotheses to test

| ID | Hypothesis | What would kill it | Stage |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | Nothing equivalent exists for Pump.fun teams | A native platform feature or a tool that splits creator fees across wallets | 2 |
| H2 | Teams want salary-style (scheduled, changeable) pay rather than a fixed split | No behavioural evidence of teams splitting fees or paying contributors | 4 |
| H3 | Creator fees are big enough to fund salaries for a meaningful number of teams | Fees concentrated in a few coins | 4 |
| H4 | Teams will pay a fee for this | Free native option; no named payer | 5 |

## Keyword expansion

1. fee sharing / fee split (Pump.fun's own term)
2. fee claimers / royalties (Bags)
3. creator rewards recipients / splits (Clanker, Zora, 0xSplits)
4. revenue share to wallets
5. payroll / web3 payroll / contributor payments (Streamflow, Request, Rise)
6. token streaming / vesting (Streamflow, Sablier, Superfluid)
7. treasury spending limits / allowance (Squads, MetaDAO)
8. creator fee claim bot / distributor / auto-claim
9. dev wallet payments / team wallet distribution
